北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京有霾，出门记得戴口罩，注意防护哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is hazy. Wear a mask when going out and protect yourself!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天微凉 13℃，记得添衣保暖，别着凉了！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy and cool at 13℃. Remember to dress warmly to avoid catching a cold!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天 14℃，微凉。外出记得带伞，多穿件衣服哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy at 14℃, a bit cool. Bring an umbrella and wear an extra layer!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云 25℃，气温舒适。记得多喝水，保持好心情！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy at 25℃, pleasant weather. Remember to hydrate and stay cheerful!
广州.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云 23℃，湿度较高。出门带伞，注意防潮哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy at 23℃ with high humidity. Bring an umbrella and mind the dampness!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天 15℃，体感微凉。出门带件外套，以免着凉。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy at 15℃, feeling a bit cool. Bring a jacket when going out to avoid catching a cold.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天 15℃，体感偏凉。记得多穿些，注意保暖哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy at 15℃, feeling cool. Remember to dress warmly.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天 21℃，体感舒适。出门记得带伞，以防小雨。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy at 21℃, comfortable. Bring an umbrella just in case of light rain.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉大雾 16℃，能见度低。驾车请慢行，注意交通安全。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy at 16℃ with low visibility. Drive slowly and mind traffic safety.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云 16℃，空气干燥。记得多喝水，润润嗓子哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy at 16℃, dry air. Remember to drink more water to keep your throat moist.
西安.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云 20℃，体感温暖。享受美好天气，保持好心情！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy at 20℃, feeling warm. Enjoy the nice weather and stay cheerful!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨 7℃ 阴天，体感寒冷。多穿厚衣，注意防寒保暖。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy at 7℃, feeling cold. Wear thick clothes and stay warm.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云 15℃，微凉。记得添衣，小心别着凉了哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy at 15℃, a bit cool. Remember to add layers and don't catch a cold.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗 21℃，阳光正好。注意防晒，享受好天气！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny at 21℃, perfect for sunshine. Remember sun protection and enjoy the good weather!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天 16℃，体感凉意。湿度大，出门带伞防潮哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy at 16℃, feeling cool. High humidity, bring an umbrella to mind the dampness.
厦门.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有霾 13℃，体感较冷。戴口罩，注意保暖防寒。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is hazy at 13℃, feeling quite cold. Wear a mask, stay warm and protected.
青岛.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连有雾 8℃，能见度低。驾车小心，注意出行安全。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is foggy at 8℃ with low visibility. Drive carefully and mind travel safety.
